comment: THE anshulrastogi.com -> sightofanshul.com REDIRECTS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT
HERE YET. Do not add them back until sightofanshul.com is attached to this
Vercel project and serving the site. The exact rules, and the order to
enable them in, are in docs/workbook-endpoint.md.
Why: a `source: '/:path*'` host redirect matches EVERY path, assets
included. Shipped while sightofanshul.com was still on registrar parking,
it 301'd /assets/index-*.js and the stylesheet to a host that served
nothing. The cached HTML still loaded, so the site returned 200 and
rendered a blank white page - which looks like a JS crash and is not one.
sightofanshul.com is still the intended canonical domain. The redirect is
correct; shipping it before the target existed was not.
